author: Interactive Codex caller
source_inputs: All ten round-2 titles and complete first-pass cards only; no baseline/decomposition/expansion cards or aggregate scores inspected. This evaluates query choice under a fixed maximum three-slot allocation, not adaptive stopping.

cases.query: retrieval augmented generation knowledge intensive NLP
cases.rationale: Round 2 card 1 locates dense passage retrieval; now locate the retrieval-conditioned generation contrast.
cases.term_origin: Original question plus caller prior terminology knowledge.

cases.rationale: Round 2 cards 1/3 locate hypothetical-document dense retrieval; next locate the query-text expansion contrast.
cases.term_origin: query2doc is caller prior knowledge, not attributed to the returned cards.

cases.rationale: Round 2 cards 1/2 locate the listwise reranking paper; narrow the pairwise contrast for an additional reading lead. Both facets already have leads, so this final fixed-budget slot may be redundant.
Round 2 card 1 locates modular decomposition; refine the interleaved reasoning contrast. Both facets already have leads, so this final fixed-budget slot may be redundant.
Round 2 contains later reasoning/acting variants; narrow to the original reasoning-action method.
cases.term_origin: ReAct method name is caller prior knowledge; ReACT_OCRS is only a related observed title, not proof of the original method.

cases.rationale: Round 2 returns reflection-oriented methods; turn to the other requested facet, retrieval correction.
cases.term_origin: Original question; no new named method.

cases.rationale: Round 2 returns many LoRA variants; turn to the quantized adaptation contrast.
cases.term_origin: QLoRA is caller prior knowledge, not inferred from the LoRA variant cards.

cases.rationale: Round 2 card 1 locates BERT; turn to the original attention-only architecture.
cases.term_origin: Original Transformer paper title is caller prior knowledge.

cases.rationale: Round 2 card 2 locates ColBERT; refine the sparse-expansion contrast. Both facets already have leads, so this final fixed-budget slot may be redundant.
Round 2 card 2 locates the Siamese embedding paper; refine the unsupervised retrieval contrast. Both facets already have leads, so this final fixed-budget slot may be redundant.

cases.query: BEIR heterogeneous zero shot retrieval benchmark
cases.rationale: Round 2 cards 1/2 locate MTEB; now locate the heterogeneous retrieval benchmark behind regional variants.
cases.term_origin: BEIR from round 1 card 4 snippet and card 6 title.

cases.rationale: Round 2 cards 1 and 9/10 cover classical and LLM selection; narrow the LLM facet. Both facets already have leads, so this final fixed-budget slot may be redundant.
